name: Wisconsin MakerSpace — Biomedical Engineer
title: Wisconsin MakerSpace
highlights: Designing and integrating a hardware solution using load sensors, ADCs, wiring, NFC readers/stickers and an ESP32 microcontroller, with Python and C firmware, to track precise material usage in 3D printers.
Calibrating analog sensor inputs into digital telemetry, transmitting real-time stock levels over Wi-Fi to an automated inventory database.
Designing climate-controlled storage in CAD and OnShape, and fabricating it with saws, lasers and 3D printing.

name: Silicon Badgers — Chip design
title: Silicon Badgers
highlights: Wrote SystemVerilog RTL and supporting code to build an ISA calculator, verified using QuestaSim.
Gained experience across the full ASIC and FPGA flow, learning software–chip interactions and chip logic/design.
Studied how neural networks use INT8/INT32 data types, memory mapping and multiply-accumulate operations.
Built up computer architecture fundamentals: instruction decoding, datapath operations and state machines.

name: Wisconsin FSAE Racing — Firmware Team
title: Wisconsin FSAE Racing
highlights: Completed embedded C onboarding on ESP32/Arduino MCUs, the foundation for the team's steering and control software.
Configured and controlled GPIO pins to read inputs and drive hardware outputs, learning firmware–physical interactions.
Used Git for version control in a shared team codebase, branching and committing through the team's GitLab workflow.
Currently developing temperature sensor firmware on ESP32 to read and process real data.

name: Medical Text Reader
title: Medical Text Reader
highlights: Built a medical text processor that translates complex medical text and prescriptions into plain, patient-friendly language, with file upload functionality created in R.
Built the Python backend, integrating the Groq Llama 3 and Gemini APIs for image processing and analysis.

name: Housing Price Simulation Model
title: Housing Price Simulation Model
highlights: Developed a house price model that simulates real wage growth, inflation and estate prices to recommend a purchase timeline, using real data and averages.
Conducted stochastic return modeling across multiple financial models and simulations, with list and dictionary storage.

name: Run Protect
title: Run Protect
highlights: Developed a web app that predicts running-related overuse injuries from biomechanical data using a rule-based composite scoring algorithm in Glide.
Built the UI/UX with HTML, CSS and JavaScript in React and Tailwind, serving 100+ users at a 10x retention rate.
Engineered the backend in Python and Java, integrating Firebase to securely collect, structure and query real-time biomechanical data.
